import hashlib, json, re
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin

root = Path('products/services/public-challenge-fixed-prize')
source = root / 'raw/nasa-bps-digital-avatar.html'
url = 'https://www.nasa.gov/directorates/stmd/prizes-challenges-crowdsourcing-program/center-of-excellence-for-collaborative-innovation-coeci/bps-digital-avatar-challenge/'
pattern = re.compile(r'herox|challenge\.gov|official rules|eligib|\bprizes?\b|\bregister\b|\bdeadline\b|\bsubmission\b|\bpayout\b|artificial intelligence', re.I)

class Announcement(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.in_main = False
        self.href = None
        self.label = []
        self.links = []
        self.excerpts = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'main':
            self.in_main = True
        if self.in_main and tag == 'a':
            self.href = dict(attrs).get('href')
            self.label = []

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'a' and self.href is not None:
            label = ' '.join(' '.join(self.label).split())
            target = urljoin(url, self.href)
            if target.startswith(('https://', 'http://')) and pattern.search(label + ' ' + target):
                self.links.append({'label': label, 'url': target})
            self.href = None
        if tag == 'main':
            self.in_main = False

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.href is not None:
            self.label.append(data)
        text = ' '.join(data.split())
        if self.in_main and pattern.search(text) and text not in self.excerpts:
            self.excerpts.append(text)

raw = source.read_bytes()
parser = Announcement()
parser.feed(raw.decode('utf-8'))
report = {'source': url, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'scope': 'Announcement main element only. Links are pointers. Uninspected rules and omitted terms remain unknown.', 'links': parser.links[:15], 'excerpts': [text[:600] for text in parser.excerpts[:15]]}
output = root / 'director-avatar-announcement-evidence.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
